title: One shared tending contract and runner for every prose store
why: Each prose store (feedback log, debts, notes, handoffs, steps, decisions) is tended its own way or not at all, so items go stale and the same fix is built many times. The feedback log incident (R27) is one case.
note: Ruling R28 (plan a96d4a3 under item 3.6, after R27). Owner 10:19 CST: "everything that marks prose should share the same \"tending\" mechanism ... it should be more uniform, standardized, and shared as much as possible to avoid stale duplication and to ensure shared best practrices". Order (box answer before 10:22 CST): a read-only skim audit (the retrospective session, running now), then this shared contract, then a deeper audit and moves. Home: a new decision for the shared contract. Shape: lint/layout.json holds per store its item shape, a "still true?" test and a close step; one runner, called from the merge check, Stop hooks, compaction and triage status; no new timer or process. Waits on the skim audit. Step feedback-log-tends-itself is its first user and waits on this step. Design input, R28 skim audit (retrospective 10:41 CST, main c85a832e2 + origin/roadmap): only generated pages and shape checks are held in CI; truth checks are rare, touched-lines only, or by hand. Pitfalls: (a) same fact twice: RULE_FILES in lint/rule_audit.py:91 and lint/check_ruling_kind.py:38 (merge/merge.py:232 a third form); roadmap/data/steps in hooks/feedback_guard.py:23 and skills/roadmap/build.py:196. (b) never close: docs/debts/notes.md (1931 lines, 191 'Until' dates nothing reads), docs/todo.md, handoff and inbox files, done roadmap steps (~390 doing), docs/plans, docs/design. (c) need a session to remember: lint/stale_cites.py --tree not in CI (108 stale cites on HEAD, 10:41 CST); roadmap upkeep only at triage build; record branch has no CI; the decision cull stopped 2026-10-19. (d) two mechanisms one job: dated-claim age in hooks/precompact_handoff.py:656-675 and skills/roadmap/build.py:1452; open item with no live owner read three ways; five task homes. (e) extend lint/layout.json kinds (path, set, record, listed) with item shape, still-true test, close step, runs-from; copy landed-dirs.txt plus lint/check_landed_dirs.py; missing kinds: output styles, handoffs, inbox, record-branch data; call points: CI steps, Stop hooks, compact sweep, hooks/daily_note.py, roadmap build. Unknown: outside pruning of handoffs and inbox; true staleness of doing steps.
source: owner 2026-11-11 10:19-10:22 CST, relayed by the retrospective session 10:23 CST
